title: Post-Incident Review and Actions
description: Produce a sourced post-incident review, create governed follow-up work, and verify improvements through completion.
setup_prompt: Use Post-Incident Review and Actions with my resolved incident data. Configure the review snapshot, impact and milestone definitions, evidence-backed analysis, review/publication path, action ownership and issue integration, verification, Slack collaboration, and dashboard.

setup_inputs.label: Resolved incident, timeline, evidence, remediation, and recovery records
Review scope, audience, template, approval, and sensitive-data policy
Action taxonomy, ownership, due-date, and verification contract
Issue, publication, and Slack destinations with authorization

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Freeze review snapshots and persist findings, actions, verification, and receipts

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Create approved follow-up work and synchronize identity and status

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks Slack bot
recommended_tools.purpose: Discuss the review and query durable follow-up action state

recommended_tools.name: Notification MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Publish an approved review or action reminder and retain delivery receipts
